name: opencode-tab-wrangler
description: Preview-first housekeeping for OpenCode V2 terminal tabs, with configurable idle cleanup, rules, locks, snoozes, a protection inspector, and Corral recovery. Closes tabs without deleting sessions; selected, running, and unknown-state tabs are protected. CLI-only; shared layouts have explicit limitations. Tested on Linux x64.

installation.summary: Merge the npm package entry into the plugins array in the global OpenCode cli.json; preserve existing settings.

usage.markdown: Open /wrangler. Defaults to preview mode. Review candidate/protection reasons before enabling automatic cleanup. Set a connection namespace and acknowledge shared layouts explicitly. Corral entries reopen tabs without deleting sessions; selected tabs in other terminals are not visible to the plugin.
